name: skillbridge
description: SkillBridge - Complete Multi-Platform Application (Web, Desktop, Mobile, PWA)

scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=@skillbridge/web" "npm run dev --workspace=@skillbridge/desktop" "npm run dev:web --workspace=@skillbridge/mobile"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:web
scripts.build:all: npm run build:shared && npm run build:web && npm run build:desktop && npm run build:mobile
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check --workspace=@skillbridge/web && npm run type-check --workspace=@skillbridge/shared && npm run type-check --workspace=@skillbridge/desktop && npm run type-check --workspace=@skillbridge/mobile
